name: Carbon Fiber Laptop Top Bag
description: A slim, hard-shell laptop bag with a carbon-fiber finish, combination code lock and fireproof zipper. Inside, a 14-section expandable document organizer (A–N), mesh pockets and card and ID slots keep a laptop, files and essentials in order.

images.caption: Product view
images.alt: Carbon Fiber Laptop Top Bag — product view
images.note: The outer shell is 0.5 mm silicone-coated fiberglass cloth. The silicone face is smooth and dustproof, so it wipes clean, and the fiberglass base does not let an open flame spread.

images.caption: Front and back views
images.alt: Carbon Fiber Laptop Top Bag — front and back views
images.note: Front with the combination code lock, and the plain back. Under the shell, a layer of EVA foam cushions knocks and drops, and its closed pores slow heat travelling inwards.

images.caption: Key features
images.alt: Carbon Fiber Laptop Top Bag — key features
images.note: The zipper is a fire-retardant metal zipper on flame-retardant tape (rated UL94 V0), so the opening is not the weak point when the bag is closed.

images.caption: Features & dimensions
images.alt: Carbon Fiber Laptop Top Bag — features & dimensions
images.note: 38.5 × 28.7 × 7.5 cm. Room for a laptop and documents behind the code lock; the shell resists wear and scratches from daily carrying.

images.caption: Document organizer
images.alt: Carbon Fiber Laptop Top Bag — document organizer
images.note: Inside the lid: a 14-section expandable organizer (A–N) for documents, two mesh pockets and a zippered mesh pocket, all protected by the same fire-resistant outer layers.

images.caption: Card & ID organizer
images.alt: Carbon Fiber Laptop Top Bag — card & id organizer
images.note: Card and ID slots for bank cards, licences and ID, plus three mesh pockets for small items.

reviewNotes: Specification matched by product type to 'EVA Laptop Bag' (08.03.0670); please confirm.

name: Multipurpose Security Bag — Shoulder Strap
description: Carry cash, mobile phones, jewellery, documents and cards safely. A code lock, carry handle and padded, adjustable shoulder strap; inside, card slots, mesh pockets and a zipped mesh pocket around a spacious main compartment.

images.caption: Product view
images.alt: Multipurpose Security Bag — Shoulder Strap — product view
images.note: Outer layer of liquid-silicone fiberglass cloth: fire retardant, waterproof and moisture-proof, and scratch-resistant so it does not mark what is inside.

images.caption: Front and back views
images.alt: Multipurpose Security Bag — Shoulder Strap — front and back views
images.note: Front and back views. A PP board spacer inside gives the bag its shape and spreads out pressure and impacts, so it keeps its form when packed.

images.caption: Features & dimensions
images.alt: Multipurpose Security Bag — Shoulder Strap — features & dimensions
images.note: 36 × 27 × 10 cm. Code lock and carry handle, plus an adjustable, padded shoulder strap for carrying cash, phones, jewellery and documents.

images.caption: Features overview
images.alt: Multipurpose Security Bag — Shoulder Strap — features overview
images.note: The same bag at a glance: card slots, mesh pockets and the main compartment, closed with a fire-retardant zipper (flame-retardant tape rated UL94 V0).

images.caption: Interior & details
images.alt: Multipurpose Security Bag — Shoulder Strap — interior & details
images.note: Inside: 8 card slots, 3 mesh pockets and a zipped mesh pocket around a spacious main compartment.

reviewNotes: Specification matched by product type to 'Fireproof document bag (shoulder strap version)' (08.05.0223); please confirm.

name: Fire & Waterproof Safety Case
description: Protects valuables from fire, water and heat. Built-in code lock and fireproof zipper; a lid organizer with a large document pocket, mesh pockets and 16 card slots, plus cash pockets and a spacious main storage compartment.

images.caption: Product view
images.alt: Fire & Waterproof Safety Case — product view
images.note: Outer shell of 0.5 mm silicone fiberglass cloth: flame retardant, waterproof (IPX5 listed) and anti-ageing, bonded so the case holds its shape.

images.caption: Fireproof & waterproof
images.alt: Fire & Waterproof Safety Case — fireproof & waterproof
images.note: Fireproof and waterproof: under the shell sits 15 mm of flame-retardant fiberglass insulation that blocks outside heat and cold and absorbs knocks.

images.caption: Features & product views
images.alt: Fire & Waterproof Safety Case — features & product views
images.note: 39 × 30 × 14 cm. Built-in code lock, fireproof zipper, fireproof stitching thread and extra-reinforced stitching, with a strong carry handle.

images.caption: Interior organizer
images.alt: Fire & Waterproof Safety Case — interior organizer
images.note: The silver lining is aluminium foil on fiberglass, rated for −40 °C to 250 °C. It reflects heat, keeps moisture out and resists mildew. Lid organizer: a large document pocket, mesh pockets and 16 card slots.

images.caption: Details & dimensions
images.alt: Fire & Waterproof Safety Case — details & dimensions
images.note: Close-ups of the built-in code lock, fireproof zipper, reinforced stitching and the carry handle.

reviewNotes: Specification matched by product type to 'Hardware Safe Case' (08.05.0224); please confirm.

name: Fire-Resistant Document Bag
description: Secure storage for your most important documents — bonds, registrations, property papers and certificates. Fire-resistant zipper and edging, a silver heat-resistant inner lining and a carry handle, in a slim, lightweight envelope.

images.caption: Product view
images.alt: Fire-Resistant Document Bag — product view
images.note: Liquid-silicone fiberglass outer: rated for continuous use from −40 °C to 200 °C and short exposure up to 800 °C, which slows the spread of fire to the papers inside.

images.caption: With handle
images.alt: Fire-Resistant Document Bag — with handle
images.note: Slim and light, with a carry handle. The outer is also waterproof and dustproof (IPX5) and resists acid, alkali and oil.

images.caption: Features & dimensions
images.alt: Fire-Resistant Document Bag — features & dimensions
images.note: 38 × 20.5 × 6.5 cm. Fire-resistant zipper and fire-resistant edging close the gaps where heat could otherwise get in.

images.caption: For important documents
images.alt: Fire-Resistant Document Bag — for important documents
images.note: Sized for important papers: bonds, registration and property papers, certificates.

images.caption: Inner lining
images.alt: Fire-Resistant Document Bag — inner lining
images.note: The silver inner lining is aluminium foil on fiberglass. It reflects heat away from documents and keeps moisture and mildew out.

reviewNotes: Specification matched by product type to 'Fireproof vertical document bag' (08.03.0671); please confirm.

name: Fireproof Battery Box
description: A rigid fireproof box for batteries and flammable equipment such as lithium-ion batteries, battery packs, power tools and drones. Combination code lock, fireproof zipper, reflective tape, adjustable carry strap, side pockets, a name-card holder and anti-slip feet.

images.caption: Product view
images.alt: Fireproof Battery Box — product view
images.note: A rigid box for lithium-ion batteries, battery packs, power tools and drones. The outer is 0.5 mm silicone fiberglass cloth: flame retardant, waterproof and wear-resistant.

images.caption: Interior
images.alt: Fireproof Battery Box — interior
images.note: Inside: the aluminium-foil fiberglass lining (−40 °C to 250 °C) reflects heat and keeps moisture out, with a zippered mesh pocket in the lid.

images.caption: Features & dimensions
images.alt: Fireproof Battery Box — features & dimensions
images.note: 39.5 × 31 × 25.5 cm. A 4 mm honeycomb board keeps the box rigid and spreads impacts; 5 mm insulation cotton lines the top and sides.

images.caption: Multiple views
images.alt: Fireproof Battery Box — multiple views
images.note: Combination code lock, fireproof zipper, two side pockets, reflective (radium) tape and an adjustable carrying strap, shown from every side.

images.caption: Back & bottom
images.alt: Fireproof Battery Box — back & bottom
images.note: Plain back and a reinforced bottom with anti-slip feet, so the box sits steady on any surface.

reviewNotes: Specification matched by product type to 'Fireproof Document Box' (08.06.0169); please confirm.
